Docs._note: Exclusions is the single source of truth shared by DocsCatalog, the csproj DocsSource Removes, and scripts/generate-docs-metadata.ps1. SectionTitles maps folder keys to display names ('' = top-level files). SectionOrder pins nav order; unlisted sections sort alphabetically after. BadgeWindowDays drives the New/Updated badges from wwwroot/docs-metadata.json (regenerate via scripts/generate-docs-metadata.ps1).

Analytics._note: Visit/download metrics database. Empty DatabasePath resolves to %ProgramData%\AKML SQL Site\analytics.db. The deploy step ACLs the folder for the IIS app pool identity. RetentionDays prunes older rows at startup (0 keeps everything). GeoDatabasePath points at a MaxMind GeoLite2 .mmdb for country/region lookup (empty resolves to %ProgramData%\AKML SQL Site\GeoLite2-City.mmdb); the file needs a MaxMind licence key -- run scripts/update-geoip.ps1 -- and the site records visits without location when it is absent. KnownProxies must list the trusted reverse proxies IF anything is ever put in front of the site (CDN, ARR, load balancer) -- while empty, forwarded headers are ignored and the client IP is the direct connection, which is correct for IIS in-process.

Downloads._note: Folder OUTSIDE the app root holding the installer files served via /dl/{file}.

Admin._note: set Admin:PasswordHash in appsettings.Production.json on the server
